steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Sequential logic circuits have memory; their output depends on both current inputs and previous states. | Key Fact: An SR latch (Set-Reset) is the simplest memory element, built from two cross-coupled NAND or NOR gates. | Key Fact: The SR latch using NOR gates: S=1,R=0 sets Q=1; S=0,R=1 resets Q=0; S=0,R=0 holds state; S=1,R=1 is invalid. | Key Fact: A D flip-flop (data) captures the D input value on the clock edge; Q follows D when clocked.
